REPORT
Date March 19, 1938.

Subject (in full) Farewell reception held by Mr. S. OKAMOTO, Japanese Consul-General.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

Some three hundred foreigners attended a reception given by the retiring Japanese Consul-General, Mr. S. OKAMOTO, at his residence at 128 Seymour Road between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m. March 18, 1938. Nothing of an untoward nature occurred during the function.

Members of the Special Branch in conjunction with personnel from Bubling Well Station carried out observation duties in the vicinity of the premises concerned from 3.45 p.m. until 6.30 p.m.

D.S. Pitts
D.S. Kamashita
C.D.S. 89

（签名：Da. Pitts）
D. S.

（左侧批注：FILE J.B.R. 19/3.）

D.C. (Special Branch).

日期：1938年3月19日。

主题（全称）：日本总领事冈本先生举行的告别招待会。

制作人：D.S. Pitts。转呈人：C. Crawford。巡官。

约三百名外侨参加了于1938年3月18日下午4时至6时，在即将离任的日本总领事冈本（S. OKAMOTO）先生位于西摩路128号的寓所举行的招待会。活动期间未发生任何意外事件。

特别分部成员会同静安寺捕房人员，于下午3时45分至6时30分在相关寓所附近执行了监视任务。

D.S. Pitts
D.S. Kamashita

Date May 8, 19 37.

Subject Arrival of Mr. S. Okamoto, new Japanese Consul-General
in Shanghai.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Mr. S. Okamoto, the recently appointed Japanese
Consul-General in Shanghai, is expected to arrive in
Shanghai from Japan on board the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru"
at about 3 p.m. May 8, 1937. Mr. S. Okamoto was
formerly the chief of the American Bureau of the Tokyo
Foreign Office.

The Consul-General will be the guest of honour at
a dinner party to be given by local Japanese residents
at the Japanese Club, Boone Road, at 7 p.m. May 10, 1937.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

主题：新任日本驻沪总领事冈本先生抵达。

新任驻沪日本总领事冈本（S. Okamoto）先生预计将于1937年5月8日下午3时左右，乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船从日本抵达上海。冈本先生此前曾任东京外务省美洲局局长。

5月10日晚7时，当地日侨将在北四川路（Boone Road）日本俱乐部举行晚宴，总领事将作为主宾出席。

Sir,

I beg to report that Mr. Okamoto, the newly appointed the
Japanese Consul General in Shanghai, arrived from Japan at the
N.Y.K.Wharf, Y'Poo Road, on board s.s. Nagasaki Maru at 3.40 p.m.

incidents occurred.
